reviews.review_description: Process was straightforward. No stressful sales, just good honest information.  Installation team were polite, professional, punctual, tidy and efficient. Neat tidy install.

Sales quoting process was helpful and professional. Assistance was provided with the planning process, necessary because of heritage overlay. All questions dealt with.Installation delayed a little, no doubt because of demand, but when started the installers were punctual, friendly and knowledgeable.Customer service fine, showed how to use charger and associated app. Grid connection was automatic following inspection, possibly because it was a replacement array. All documentation provided.

Sales experience - 10/10Install Coordination - 4/10Installation - 6/10Customer service was amazing before I signed contact. Once handed over to install coordination I lost every bit of contact. I received no updates, when I called I was told I would receive a call back which I did not.Was told 3-4 weeks for install at contract signing, was told 3-4 weeks at week 3 when I called for an update. Was called at end of week 5 to offer me 1 day 1 week out. I had charity commitments that day, so they said they would call me back the next week as they can only book 1 week on advance.During the follow up I was given 14 hours notice they needed to complete a second inspection, this was the first time I found out this inspection was required, I moved my schedule around to od my best not to delay in the install.During week 5 I had to threaten to cancel to get any form of commitment of when my install will take place.Install was completed week 7.No install reminderInstaller arrived at 6:59am and left at 7pm.I found out at 7pm they expect me to dispose of all the rubbish. This included- boxes the battery and inverted came in- pallets the panels and battery were delivered on- off cuts / left overs of metal rails, cables, paperwork/manuals- installers lunch containers and drink cansI had to argue regarding the largest pallet (1.5x2m) as it would not fit in my SUV.I spent 4 hours sorting and doing two full trips to the tip to dispose of everything.The quality of the install does look to to be good quality.However during the process I found myself recommending my friends installer, as I could not recommend my experience to people I like.

Great service from a quick response, professional and punctual sales person, office updates, installation, and their referral to inspection. Everyone was great and helpful to guide us through what might have been a very intimidating process. It was also a very quick process.
First class in all areas. Great service good clean up   Great follow up with an issue. Sales person Pat had great knowledge and advice. Installers very good

Overall the installation was satisfactory. Timely and polite. The crew need to be a bit better cleaning up when finished. In particular it is poor form leaving cigarette butts around. This might be out of the scope of the installers duties, however, we would have appreciated an explanation of how the system works.

After extensive research we chose Zeco Energy to install 12.5kW solar panels with a 13.5kW Tesla Powerwall 2 battery storage system and EV Charger to our home and we are extremely satisfied with our decision. The installation was carried out in a seamless timely manner by very organised professional tradesmen who were also very respectful. The system is functioning perfectly as promised and producing energy well in excess of our requirements. We have no hesitation in affording Ian and his time our highest recommendation to anyone contemplating installing a blackout proof long term solar investment such as we have done.

Zeco were fantastic to deal with. Polite, punctual, and professional throughout. They were flexible in helping us size the system, explained everything clearly, and kept us well-informed. The install was smooth and hassle-free, and their pricing was very competitive. Highly recommended!

From my initial enquiry to ZECO Energy for a solar system upgrade and heat pump hot water installation at home I found all members of the ZECO Team most approachable, professional and pleased to assist with my range of clarification queries I had throughout the entire process to provide for a value for money integrated renewable energy system at home. A desire to provide quality and helpful customer service clearly stood out in all my interactions with the ZECO Team, including a site visit to check out their business premises.This excellent service extended to the contractors and their sub-contractors who installed the system at home. Noting I can be very critical of workmanship standards (retired Engineer) I found the standard of works excellent from the initial pre-work site inspection to final clean-up and commissioning of the system.If you are considering exploring opportunities for renewable energy at home, I genuinely recommend a conversation with the Team at ZECO Energy to assist you with informative and cost-effective options.

Josh from Zeco met with me and took on board my slightly unusual requirements for the installation:I didn't want any information about generation or consumption going from the inverter to the grid operator or the inverter company.I also didn't want any organisation to have the ability to switch off the system without my permission.I still wanted to be able to access consumption and generation data within my home network.In fact, I wanted to operate the whole setup without any internet connection or account with the installer or anybody else.On the first two requirements, Josh and Zeco were able to set me up with a Sigenstor inverter.  They checked with SigEnergy to make sure it could be operated without an internet connection, and that it would still be covered under warranty.  This is not the way the usual install goes, but they were able to accommodate my requirements.I chose not to receive a feed-in tariff so as to avoid becoming part of the "backstop", as that would have enabled the grid-operator to turn off my system if they felt like it.  The feed-in tariff is low enough now that I expect to make my money back by saving electricity instead of exporting it.It took a bit of close coordination with their electrical engineer (thanks again Janak) to enable MODBUS to scrape the usage and generation data via WiFi, but that works well now and I have integrated it with my home server.I have an old house providing challenges in situating the inverter and the battery while adhering to planning codes, but the panels and inverter/battery were nonetheless installed very professionally in a single day, and it looks great.  Neat work, and the panels and inverter/battery combo themselves are good-looking imho.TLDR good looking, installed in one day, and good communication.

Sales rep was knowledgeable and presented the information well. Installation team was excellent on the day. Got everything done efficiently and minimised any mess on the property. Personnel behaved professionally and worked with care and skill.

The Sales person who initially visited the premises was extremely professional and informative which is what made me decide to go with Zeco Energy even though I had a cheaper quote from a different installer. The installation process was seamless and the property was clean when they finished.

The salesperson visited in person and spent the time required to cover all the details. He even spotted some details others had missed.Installation was well organised and they took all rubbish away. Could have cleaned up the dust a little better but typical tradies.There was a small issue with the heat pump installation but this was addressed in a reasonable timeframe.Still waiting for completion of the grid connection but I suspect this is due to my distributor.Will be recommending them to others.

Zeco were a pleasure to deal with. Right from the initial consultation through to installation and commissioning, they ensured that we understood what was happening and happily responding to any questions that we had. They made the whole process so easy. I would have no hesitation in recommending them to anyone looking to go solar and wanting an excellent experience.

Zeco were the only company who attended the property and completed the quote face to face answering all my questions and gave me a number of options. After installation I was shown how to use the App and next steps with Certificate of Compliance.

All quotes were similar, including one I sourced independently. I went with Zeco because Josh from sales was the only provider (aside from the one I sourced myself), to actually visit the property. Josh was also the most helpful in the myriad of questions I had, as this process does not seem to be a straight line. Zeco was able to deliver the system that I had settled on, with the other providers being set on the product they were “selling”. Whilst this was probably true for Zeco as well, the combination of all the above, was decisive.The only “complaint” I would have, is that once past the sales stage, I would have preferred to have been referred to a “project manager” that would be present at the day of installation, and any subsequent follow up. The day before the installation I thought that I had that when someone came to assess the site, but I never saw him again. I had to request “a favour” a second time when the installation crew arrived in the morning. I had to source “replacement tiles”, for which the colour of roof tiles are no longer available, but I had a match otherwise. I asked both if it was possible to switch out those tiles for what would be underneath the panels, and both said “no problem”. It wasn’t done, so that is a minor disappointment.Otherwise, the installation crew did an excellent job, and were clean and tidy.After installation I noticed on the Enphase app, that the panel array map had not been uploaded. I had to revert to Josh once again, who was able to follow up and rectify that. Without a project manager, I don’t know if that was an expected thing, or an oversight on the day. The crew was done in a day, and I sensed that this was a tight schedule. Previously, I was told that it would take a day and a half.Follow up with the inspector was good, and that occurred a few business days later, but there has been no communication coming from our energy retailer as yet. When we contacted them they said they have not received anything from Zeco (at that point) and provided “correct” email addresses to forward to the company. After we did so, we were advised that we needed to wait for the energy retailer to contact us, or wait until the next bill. A month later and I’m none the wiser.There was a billing kerfuffle when the “final invoice” came, being $2,000 over the quoted price. Once again I had to contact Josh, who was able to get that rectified a few days later. However, I suspect that this may have been a complication from the VicSolar rebate. The installer scanned the barcode VicSolar had sent me, but I had to email that sometime after the installation to yet another person (who I presume works in their accounts).All up, satisfactory. But as with any complex trades business, there are always “complications”.

Out of 5 Solar co's I contacted, Pat is the only one from ZECO who came to site to explain the process and give a quote.Their quote out of the 5 I received was also the most competitive using a well established inverter and the current best performing solar panels currently available.Installation was quick and efficient and the installers were very tidy with any excess rubbish being collected a few days later, something that has not happened from my experience with other Solar co's.All round painless and great experience.
The installation team were very professional and did a first class installation. I am just waiting for it to be commissioned and start saving me money.
Sales quotation process was excellent and informativeGood work by installers - again helpful and informative and adaptable.More time needed on instructing how to use.

After payment of the deposit, the installation was scheduled fairly quickly and was completed in 2 days, including removal of our old system. The work was done neatly. Note it takes up to two week for an inspector to come and ok the system for actual use.Too early to tell how good the customer service is.

ZECO were the right choice  for my Journey for Solar BatteryJosh from Zeco came out for site visit and helped me with options within my budget - He was the only vendor that came out others I received quotes for worked of photos I sent - which I thought was lackingI choose sigenergy battery as they may be new but were a good alternative to my original choice of Telsa powerwall3 and was cheaperThe installers were top notch - There were ontime and polite cleaned up after the installThere were some issues with montoring post install but Zeco tech support quickly solved this within a dayThank you Josh, Vasih and Doshy from Zeco for your quick turn around and responsivenessIts only just been installed But I would say that I am very happy with the battery already utlization from the grid is minimal

First, we would like to thank Solar Quotes for providing great inforamtion to understand what we should consider when looking at upgrading and choosing a solar installer.We greatly appreciate this support in providing such information.Our process of updating from an old system to our new 12.69 kw solar system, plus battery and Reclaim heat pump with Zeco energy was fantastic.We highly recommend Zeco because they listened and understood what we are trying to do at our house with our 3 phase power.Which is totally get rid of gas supply and rely on solar.From the first contact with Zeco helping and advising the best system for our home was a great experience.Zeco energy responded to any questions as we had regarding our system.Our solar installer did an amazing job installing our system and really went above and beyond the call of duty in setup, as well help me with the final programming of the Reclaim heat pump setup. Which I had trouble with.As well, any questions and advice on our solar was explained.You wouldn't have known they were here as clean up was spotless.These guys are an asset to the industry.We are preparing for split systems and induction top in the near future so we can then get rid of the gas to the house altogether.We will call upon Zeco energy to do this work as their work has been amazing and we trust them to get the right setup for our future.When choosing a solar installer, do your homework, ask questions, discuss with them why you want such a system now and going forward for your home.Go with someone who wants to share that information and help you understand more about this technology.We trust Zeco energy and highly recommend this team of experts.Thank you Zeco energy for helping us prepare for a future less reliant on such things as gas.J and J

All went well: assistance in the applications for our Fed & State Governments incentives, removal of our old solar system, supply, installation, & commissioning of a new solar system with a solar battery, & follow-up.

Josh from Zeco was outstanding, he explained the difference between the systems and ensured we had the best solar solution to meet our needs. The installers were excellent, friendly, explained how to use the system and left our house clean and tidy on completion. Post installation and the mandatory audit - the final process which we are awaiting is to connect to the grid which is again arranged by Zeco sending all the paperwork to the provider. In summary, if you are considering Solar install - I strongly recommend Zeco as your company of choice.

Marc provided a reasonable quote for the quality of the product and answered any and all questions that came up. Installation was a bit rocky due to circuit breaker problems and installation around Christmas time but completed in full working order.

Apart from a blown fuse on the GIV Energy battery which has been fixed and no recurrence. It all went very well.I love "no mess" tradespeople!Independent inspector found a couple of labelling issues which were fixed promptly.There is a technical issue which my supplier is resolving with the distribution company on its ability to control PV export. (Victorian legislation for PV post 1 Oct 2024).

We were very happy with Zeco as an installer. Sales came to our house to talk through the options, the only one out of three.They weren’t pushy sales and we liked their product even though it was the mid range quote.Whilst we had to follow up with install dates, we were really happy with the great job the team did on our two story roof. They put the panels in a couple of different spots but it all looks so neat and tidy. They were a great team of installers too.Very happy and solar is doing an amazing job at bringing down our bills!!!

The Zeco team were amazing. Josh Allen was my Sales Engineer. Josh came to my house and talked me through the options. He was polite and friendly and not pushy. He definitely knew what he was talking about.On the day of installation Abdul Brenzai and his team were onsite on time and worked until nearly 7pm to get the install done in one day. They were neat and tidy and very respectful.After install I reached out to Josh with some questions and he was super helpful and responded quickly.Would highly recommend Zeco!
Great installation and installer very good. Need and tidy installation following all the legal requirements exactly. Helpful with all questions asked. Installer very thorough.
Quotes were timely and all questions answered promptly.Installations was seamless, timely very polite and very tidy.Very accessible help and prompt inspection.Highly recommended
Sales and quote was great - gave four options to choose from.Installer was punctual informative and tidy,Organised the grid connection and showed how to use the charger.

Zeco were the only quoter who actually visited my home and discussed my solar needs. Their quote accurately reflected our requirements and was more than competitive with the other quoters who assessed our needs via Google maps and a phone call. Coincidently, a friend of mine had also used Zeco and was happy with their installation.The  installers were polite, friendly and professional.  There was a small accident (they do happen) and they were responsive to rectifying the damage to the standard required by me.The follow up aspects such as commissioning the new solar system, arranging the government rebate  and showing us how to use it were all done in an efficient and professional manner.All-in-all I would recommend Zeco to anybody considering going solar.
Amazing service from start to finish. Onsite inspection and quote provided by a friendly salesperson. Very transparent with quote and timelines. Installed on time and cleaned up after!

The sales/ quoting process was very clear from the beginning. Marc the salesman, was very good and very helpful. He included everything that I requested to, advising me of all the different options of panels and inverter to choose.They also remove and dispose my old 1.5kW 8 panels system.I must say that your Solar Quotes brochure - Solar 101 - A Beginner's Guide helped me a lot in my final decisions.The installation went really well. The installer was very punctual and explained what he was going to install in order for me to check it against the approved quote. Left the place very clean and tidy.Zeco's customer service is to be commended. They helped me to organize everything required to get the grid connection after the install.As I also organised to install an EV Charger in my garage (supplied by me), the installer and Zeco made sure that everything was working well and also showed me the best way of how to use it.I am very happy with the final outcome and currently enjoying the solar panels installation as well as the EV Charger.

I got 3 references, asking for a visit prior to quoting. One did not even contact me, one gave me a quote without a visit or a discussion of my needs, but Zeco have been impeccable all along and I am happy with the whole process with them.

ZECO provided a number of options for different budgets and configurations. The installation was carried out neatly and professionally, polite guys and left neat with no rubbish. Ryan explained the instal and operation as well.  The turned up on time and did exactly what they said. The workers were safe and used a scissor lift .  Grid connection yet to be done waiting for the inspection.

I had already organised two quotes from other companies, so I only asked you for one company.You recommended Zeco.I am very happy with the service I received from them.They contacted me promptly and arranged a visit.The person who came was very knowledgeable. He explained the various options, and walked around the property to get an idea of possibilities.Zeco then sent me two quotes. They also provided URLs I could check out, to do my own research about the products suggested.Their quotes were considerably lower that the other other two companies I had found on my own.After choosing one of the options, they arranged everything for me - rebates, installation, certification, etc.At all times Zeco kept me informed on what was going on, anything I had to do, and next steps.Before starting, the installer reassessed the placement of the panels, and made some adjustments; and spent some time discussing with me, the best place for the inverter. He was very helpful, even going so far as to remount a wall decoration that had to moved to accommodate the inverter. They were also extremely tidy, clearing away all mess.At all times Zeco staff were very professional. They listened to my concerns/suggestions, and patiently explained why they were doing things in a certain way.I'm still waiting on the final steps, but based on my experience so far, I'd highly recommend them.And thank you, for suggesting them.

ZeCO provided the quotes and the information in a timely manner, I appreciated their professionalism and the quick responses.Installation has been polite, tidy and punctual with no issues at all.As for the moment every interaction with the customer service has been smooth and easy, getting the answers in timely manner

We reached out to find an installer via SolarQuotes after being visited by a door knocker and talked into signing a contract to install a 6.6kw system.The door knocker installer was pushy and I felt like I wasn't being listened to when asking questions about a larger system.After watching the videos on SolarQuotes and reading the material I was convinced we made a mistake signing the contract with the door knocker and cancelled it (was still within the cooling-off period).SolarQuotes referred us to Zeco Energy, who visited us at our property.The SolarQuotes salesperson was a night and day contrast to the door knocker, he answered all my questions, addressed all my concerns and quoted me a larger 13.3 kw system for the SAME PRICE as what I was sold by the door knocker for a 6.6kw system!After signing the new solar install contract with Zeco Energy the service we received throughout the process was phenomenal, communication was clear throughout the entire process and the install was done in a day. The install was clean without conduit coming out from under the eaves and all cabling concealed and tucked away.Overall we are very happy with the service Zeco Energy has provided and the system is producing away already saving us money on our power bills.

The sales / quoting process was great. They attended the site without a desktop quote and looked over the requirements, including the switchboard and connections to the street. The salesman certainly seemed to know his stuff and gave us confidence to proceed.The contracted installers were great. Polite and efficient.BUT!!!We installed a 10kW system in December, and the installers found that our switchboard and connection to the grid could not cope with a system this size. We operated on a 7kW for 5 months. Zeco said it was not their fault. Luckily, the installers took pity on us and recommended an electrician to upgrade the mains etc.So... it is now May and extra $3,000 and 5 months later we may actually be able to use the 10kW that was designed, installed and paid for in June or July this year once the lines have been upgraded.Also - we purchased a heat pump hot water system from them at the same time, which was installed at the same time. Unfortunately, they made a mistake and installed the wrong size system, which was only picked up when I checked the certification documents. This issue has now been rectified and the correct system installed.

Rhys at Zeco was helpful, honest, and very informative. It was thanks to his customer service that I proceeded with this company. The installation was extremely professional, efficient, and friendly, and of course the price was competitive.

Marc contacted us about the quote, came to inspect our house and was very friendly, professional and punctual. He responded to our questions very quickly and was always clear and concise in the information he provided.The installation process went very well. The team (installers and ZECO designer Janak) responded really well to an installation hiccup and came up with an acceptable alternative. The installers were friendly, professional, punctual and were very tidy.The post installation experience with ZECO has also been very good.

This review is a tale of two different experiences.We dealt with sales, who was absolutely fantastic. He patiently explained the whole process, and answered all of my questions (thanks to Solar Quotes for arming me with the information that I needed).Once the installation left sales capable hands, the process was terrible. Zeco work with (or are the same company) an energy retailer called Nectr. My account wasn't created properly so it took more than 3 weeks, and getting sales involved to have everything fixed up.It took 3 months to have the installation done (from March 2023 to install at start of June 2023), and then another 12 business days to have ESV do the inspection to turn the system on.I provided feedback to Zeco on their lack of communication and my subsequent frustrations and was met with terrible customer service as a response - both blaming things that were outside their control, and informing me that the delay was due to me receiving an offer that wasn't on their system and that they wouldn't be offering these type of bundles to customers in the future (ok?). All I was after was an acknowledgement that the process hadn't gone smoothly and a commitment to follow up in the future.
This was a seamless process from the initial sales call through to quoting, site survey and installation.  Everyone involved was friendly and professional.
Great service and technical advice. Very happy with the end result.

After the initial contact and visit to my location, I promptly received quotations from ZECO for three suitable battery systems.I researched each system and compared the costs with other quotes and asked questions, which Mark Spicer answered to my satisfaction, and decided to accept the recommended Tesla system.Following a long delay in obtaining a loan from VicSolar, during which ZECO support was helpful and patient, a date for installation was set for early December.However, due to an unusual rainy November and a high demand for installations, the installation date was changed to late in December.The process took place on the appointed day, and Rick did a professional job with the installation. A technical glitch prevented grid connection on that day, but this was overcome the next day, with Tesla support. ZECO also helped to apply for a rebate via the Tesla app.Overall, I am very satisfied with the whole process and very happy that I chose ZECO for this project.

Initially off to a bad start with the Sales person not turning up, however when rearranged he was extremely knowledgeable and spent all the time we needed.  He listened to what or future needs and goals were.We asked for a couple of alternatives which were both good options and good quality and a good price one of which we chose. Sales person was always happy to take my calls and questions.  He was very helpful explaining the process for sole rebates and loan options.The original sales person then left and Zeco were very pro-active in making contact to ensure we had an account manager.The panel design on the roof is well placed and provides optimum efficiency.The inverter is well placed and it was encouraging to discuss where things like the battery and/or the EV charger may go in relation to it should we want one.The installers were very efficient and organised as well as approachable.  Minimal mess and a tidy job.It took a few days to get account created so I could monitor the Solar and an application to be put into United Energy to initiate compliance check.All in all, it was a very positive experience and we would definitely recommend and got with Zeco again if needed.

After many quotes and many phone discussions a friend recommended Ian Lilley at Zeco. Ian then had Pat Briscoe consult with me. Pat was happy to do a site inspection prior to quoting as the job was quite complex (many other companies did not offer this service).Many quote variations later Pat and his team came up with a plan that I was completely satisfied with.The job was scheduled quickly and the installers were extremely prompt and tidy and all was completed at a minimum of fuss.I am a very satisfied customer and gladly recommend Zeco Energy to all.

From first call with Rhys, who quoted and changed system details for me when I asked. He was friendly and available to answer any questions. My installation was a bit challenging, due to being a double storey with flat roof, however Vincent and his team were amazing. They were polite,friendly and professional. Installation took 1 and half days. Zeco customer service was excellent, they were always responsive and helpful. System was installed one week, inspection and turned on following week.
Great experience both sales and installation, all made easy no fuss.

Out of the several companies that provided quotes for our solar installation (3 from SolarQuotes, 2-3 from external), only ZECO that made time to actually come to our property, and assess the feasibility of the installation. This means that they can give a more accurate quotation and proposal.This turns out to be especially important because not only our switchboard is north-facing, it's also not shielded (no shade), and there is a hot water system nearby, meaning that the inverter & battery needs to be installed somewhere else - something that other installers wouldn't be able to pick up just from satellite photos.Patrick from ZECO explained the process very clearly, providing a lot of information, as well as options from budget to top-of-the-line with pros and cons. He showed his own solar install, some learnings from his own experiences, as well as the importance of properly sizing our installation. He was more than happy to answer any questions, even after the site visit. He never once pushed for upsells or anything similar.Although the quotation used a lower rates than offerred by the electricity provider, Patrick understood and explained to us that we were able to void the contract if we choose to do so. This coupled with site visit and no upsells basically what made us decide to go ahead with ZECO. The fact that we chose to go with QCELLS all-in-one solution, and ZECO is a QCELLS is a bonus.The ZECO team kept us updated in every single step of the solar install, from when to apply for the VIC rebate, the installation process, what to do after, and so on. The installation team was punctual, professional, and very tidy. Although I am not an electrician, I can see that the panels were installed very neatly.After the system was installed, the ZECO team still continue to answer any questions that I had about the install, feed-in, grid connection, and even helped to troubleshoot a minor issue.Few weeks in and we can 100% see that our system was properly sized, and works as expected. Overall, we couldn't be happier. We wouldn't hesitate to recommend ZECO to others!
Sales team was excellent and so was the installation team.They did organise the grid connection

Sales and quotation process were excellent. Zeco sent someone out to inspect the site.All questions were answered and suggestions given.Installation was punctual and not as tidy as expected.Customer service in general was ok. Overall am happy with the installation.

After getting quotes from 5 solar companies—3 from solarquotes and 2 from elsewhere—I dove into weeks of phone calls, messages, and emails discussing panels, inverters, and batteries. It was a bit of a journey, but after careful research, Zeco Energy emerged as the perfect fit with the best bang for my buck.Zeco Energy went above and beyond in setting up my 13.2kW solar system with QCells panels, a SolarEdge 10kW inverter, and a SolarEdge 10kW battery. The whole process, from start to finish, felt like a breeze, thanks to their professionalism and expertise.The consultation with Charles T. was fantastic. He took the time to get my energy needs and crafted a plan that aligned perfectly with my goals. Charles patiently walked me through the benefits of QCells panels and the SolarEdge inverter, making me feel confident in my choice.The installation took just 3 days, considering a bit of weather interference. The Zeco Energy crew worked like clockwork, showcasing their technical prowess. What stood out was their attention to detail—every panel was perfectly placed, and the wiring was impressively organized. It's clear they take pride in their work.The SolarEdge 10kW inverter and 10kW battery have been rockstars in my quest for energy independence. Zeco Energy's recommendation of these high-quality components has proven spot-on. The inverter's ability to maximize energy production and the battery's storage capacity have significantly cut my reliance on the grid.Throughout the process, Zeco Energy's commitment to customer satisfaction was evident. They kept me in the loop at every stage, and every question or concern I had was promptly addressed by their team, from installers to designers and sales.In conclusion, I wholeheartedly recommend Zeco Energy to anyone considering solar. Their expertise, professionalism, and top-tier equipment make them a standout choice in the renewable energy game. Choosing Zeco Energy not only boosted the sustainability of my home but also gave me confidence in my decision to go solar with them.

The sales and quoting was very easy and friendly. They explained all the pros and cons of each system and brand. They have fantastic installers who take pride in their work. Excellent customer service and held my hand throughout the whole process.

Sales process was fine and rep was knowledgeable. Installation guys were friendly and efficient but left some mess and damaged plants. Application to our retailer was submitted nearly 2 weeks late so still no FITs being paid. Not a big deal but when they tell you it’s because they were busy it’s a bit ordinary.
Was easy to deal with and organised connection within 24 hours. Great experience.

The process from Solar quotes was much easier than trying to source individual companies fro quotes & having to repeat what you "think" you needed. First Installer called within 6 hours followed quickly next day by second Solar Company...the third didn't contact us at all, although when prompted by a reminder from Solar quotes immediately got in touch and apologises to "losing" the lead and within 24 hours had also quoted.My only concern was there was quite a wide divergence in quality of equipment proposed and therefore also cost...we decided on quality with extendable options for EV, Battery or extra panels down the track...the system chosen was superior and not even offered by the other companies, so there was a lack of apples v apples.Zeco very supportive along the way and very responsive to our questions, queries & adjustments!! to the scope...very accommodative. The Install team of Ryan Bulmer were very impressive...quality install, all completed within 5 hours and very polite and informative...our Inspector arrived the very next morning so all good to go within less than a day!!!Now we only completed yesterday so unsure on grid connection & advising Energy provider, but based on efforts so far have little to be concerned with!!Thanks Ian & Charles at ZECO and Ryan of RTB Electrics of Somerville we are sure we will have something that will last the journey & help alleviate this huge bill increases everyone is now facing!!CheersAlec & Sue

I found ZECO to be an efficient and quality solar supply and installation company to deal with. The whole process was simplified by them and they were always informative about any queries I had.Our installer, Habib, was very good. He was informative, helpful about any questions I had and was well organised.
